_about: T-594 (DAEMONS vision 9.36), written by DAEMONS tools/gensongs.py through companion_export.py -- never edit by hand. parts: a form's own part of its line's song (notes [midi, beats, the share of the part at which it is learned], bass [midi, beats], bpm, its key, and the levels it is learned between: from, the level its form begins, to, the level it is perfect at). songs: a species' song, its line's forms oldest first. window: how much of its part static takes to close on a note; static: its candidates, steps along the key from the true note, the first kept longest, and its hiss. summons (T-598, C-419): each daemon's OPENING as PLAY's freestyle listens for it -- [the key wheel it is played on (a minor song on its relative major's), its pitch classes in order, null where any button stands for a note the wheel cannot play]; heard at the end of what was played, octave-blind. shiny (T-602, C-482): the notes a SHINY sings that its kind does not -- a form's [index into its part's notes, the MIDI note a shiny sings there], from DAEMONS tools/genshinysongs.py; a form not listed sings its kind's part. T-613 THE VERSES: a part is its form's VERSE, set to its quote a note a syllable (its INDEX entry standing in until T-599 writes it), its first seven notes its HOOK (its summon, unique in shape); a note's beats hold the rest after it, and it sounds at most ring beats. chorus: a final form's hidden CHORUS, one run between each two of its verses (notes [midi, beats], bass, its key), sung only once the final form knows its own verse whole; words, a few words shown in italics between the verses' quotes. Every note DRAFT.
